messages:
Anya: quick sync — I need a small contract clarification for chat streaming. Are we guaranteed to receive a final `tool_call` chunk (tool_call.final = true) before the stream ends when a tool is invoked? :eyes:
Ryan: not guaranteed in all backcompat modes. current runtime may emit a finalization in the same delta or omit it and send a separate 'tool_complete' event later. which path are you hitting?
Anya: seeing clients that rely on final flag present in the last delta and break if it's missing. this is from a hosted -> dedicated edge case where an older gateway sharded responses.
Taylor: fwiw the spec we landed says: "tool_call may be expressed across multiple deltas; a finalization marker SHOULD be emitted but consumers must tolerate missing explicit final marker and instead treat stream close + tool payload as final." maybe that wording needs tightening.
Kevin: +1 to tightening. For SDKs we added heuristics: if a delta contains `tool_call.args` and next delta doesn't include more tool_call fragments before stream close, we mark it final. But we need explicit guidance for third-party clients.
Anya: can we pick one of these options? 1) require explicit `tool_call.final` before EOS, or 2) keep current tolerant behavior but document heuristics and provide a deprecation plan. which is easier to implement?
Ryan: impl-wise 2 is safer short-term. forcing explicit final will break older proxies. we could introduce a header `X-Stream-Finality: strict` on newer routes that opt into stricter semantics. SDKs could opt in.
Taylor: that's a good compromise. propose: default = tolerant; add opt-in `finality=strict` query param or header. update convo contract doc + add note in streaming FAQ.
Anya: sweet. can we also confirm field names for tool args when streaming partials? some clients expect `tool_call.args` to be string-contiguous, others expect chunk array.
Kevin: canonical shape we want is: `tool_call: { name: string, args_chunk: string }` where runtime concatenates `args_chunk` in order. we'll keep `args` deprecated and emit `args_chunk`. but we need a short migration note.
Anya: ok. timeline? small PR to convo-spec + one-liner in changelog so SDKs can pick up. I can draft.
Ryan: ticket created: ENGPLAT-5421 — add header opt-in and mark `args` deprecated. please link PRs.
ci-bot: build passed for branch convo-spec/finality-optin (commit 9fa3b2) :white_check_mark:
Taylor: once Anya posts the PR I can do a quick review (non-blocking). also add an example snippet for clients showing heuristic fallback: ```
// pseudo fallback
let buffer = ''
for (delta of stream) {
  if (delta.tool_call?.args_chunk) buffer += delta.tool_call.args_chunk
  if (delta.tool_call?.final) { useTool(buffer); buffer = '' }
}
// on stream close: if (buffer) useTool(buffer)
```
Kevin: agree, include note about ordering: delta sequence numbers are the canonical ordering; if a proxy reorders, we can't guarantee correctness. so recommend using sequence numbers or monotic offsets.
Anya: thanks all — I'll open the convo-spec PR and link ENGPLAT-5421. tagging @Ryan @Taylor for follow-up reviews. :pray:
